question: Does guided Socratic reflection improve reasoning relative to independent reflection?
hypothesis: Participant-mean post-minus-pre accuracy is greater in the Socratic condition.
primaryOutcome: Difference between conditions in participant-mean accuracy change
design: Between-participant randomized pilot, 5–10 consenting volunteers; fixed task bank and matched review time. Human launch approval and final question review required.
exclusions: Technical failures and answer leakage marked separately; never silently switch conditions. Report all starts and completion reasons.
analysis: Descriptive participant-level comparison; no confirmatory p-value or causal efficacy claim from a small pilot.
